thread:
pagerbot: PAGER: auth-service (eu-west-1) — sudden spike of 401s from clustered IPs; volume +600% in 5m. tagging sec-oncall and sre-oncall :rotating_light:
maya_sec: I'm on it. collecting auth logs and checking WAF rules now.
tom_sre: will isolate the node group behind auth lb and rollback any recent deploy if needed. giving ETA 10m.
lia_platform: FYI saw a deploy 2m before spike to auth-service:feature/debug-logger. rolling back if confirmed.
eli_seceng: quick question — do we have any indicators of log export to external buckets? checking CloudTrail + S3 PutObject.
maya_sec: grep through forwarder logs for Authorization headers. found ~12 cleartext Bearer tokens in /var/log/forwarder/2026-09-12.log (may be staging-forwarder config pushed to prod).
harry_cs: hearing from customer 'delta-pay' that they saw 502s around same time. possible customer-facing impact.
jen_legal: please preserve logs; do not scrub until forensics confirms PII. legal holds evidence.
lia_platform: deploy-bot triggered rollback: `/deploy rollback auth-service v2.3.1 -> v2.3.0` — starting now.
deploy-bot: Rollback initiated by lia_platform (job 9876). ETA ~4m for new replicas.
tom_sre: isolating affected ASG, throttle inbound ELB to 10rps for auth-service to reduce amplification.
maya_sec: blocking offending CIDR ranges on WAF and adding temporary deny on edge. list of IPs: 193.21.45.0/24, 45.33.12.9. applying now.
eli_seceng: CloudTrail shows S3 PutObject to a third-party bucket at 2134567700 by svc-forwarder-role. Pulling object keys for analysis.
maya_sec: plan (short): 1) block IPs, 2) rollback debug deploy, 3) rotate affected service tokens, 4) assess customer impact and notify.
lia_platform: rotation plan: kick off service token rotation for svc-forwarder and svc-auth, update envs via secret-manager, rolling restart. scripting now: `./scripts/rotate-service-keys --services svc-forwarder,svc-auth --concurrent 2`
tom_sre: starting rotation runbook step 1. live-run logs: `rotate-job/2134567890.log` streaming to /tmp. marking maintenance. ETA 20m.
harry_cs: I'll prepare a 'we're investigating' banner for delta-pay and outline mitigation steps; hold customer-facing details until legal ok.
jen_legal: legal requests: preserve original S3 objects, snapshot affected instances, and collect IAM audit logs. once forensics confirms no PII, we can redact and issue notice.
maya_sec: found evidence that debug-logger wrote auth headers due to env var ENABLE_DEBUG=true on forwarder. pushing a hotfix to remove header logging and redeploying config.
eli_seceng: S3 object list attached (forensics only): s3://suspicious-uploads/forensic-2134567890-*. do not share externally.
lia_platform: rollback complete, new replicas healthy. auth 401 rate down ~70% since WAF block.
maya_sec: starting token revocation: revoking active tokens issued by svc-auth for last 24h, rotating JWT signing key (KMS key alias/aws/jwt-svc-auth -> new key). will coordinate with onboarding to avoid mass customer disruption.
tom_sre: toggling fallback routing to dedicated auth cluster to absorb traffic while rotation completes.
harry_cs: delta-pay reporting auth errors decreased to baseline; monitoring.
jen_legal: filing incident ticket INC-20260912-2134 and notifying infra security leads. also request retention hold for 90 days on related logs.
maya_sec: quick remediation checklist posted to ops: `- WAF deny rules applied
- debug-logger flag removed
- rollback executed
- service tokens rotated (in progress)
- forensic snapshots preserved
- customer comms draft with legal review`
eli_seceng: one open action: scrub any hosted logs stored in third-party bucket after forensic capture. coordinate with bucket owner to schedule secure deletion and get deletion confirmation.
lia_platform: rotation job reports 0/120 failures so far, 3 minutes remaining.
maya_sec: once rotation done, we'll publish post-mortem and list mitigation (no UI-facing PII leaked, only bearer tokens found in server-side debug logs).
harry_cs: hold customer notice until jen_legal signs off. I'll stand by to send on approval. :thumbsup: 
jen_legal: thumbs up. continue with forensics. escalate to SOC lead if any new exfil detected.
maya_sec: forensics show no downloads beyond the PutObject event. closing live triage; moving to investigation phase. will update INC ticket with timeline and artifacts.
lia_platform: thanks team — handoff to sec-eng and legal for follow-up. I'm removing maintenance flag.
pagerbot: RESOLVED: auth-service incident (2134567890) — traffic normalized, rollback and WAF applied, key rotation in progress. further updates in INC-20260912-2134 thread.
